findings.summary: The first implementation rendered the problem/stale/checking `Проверить` control as a disabled button. The auditor treated this as a command surface despite the absence of dispatch metadata.

orchestrator_adjudication.resolution: Replaced the disabled button with an inert `span.quick-start-row-action` carrying `aria-disabled="true"`; kept the icon/text visual marker; added test coverage for no `data-ui-action`, no dataset action, and no status dot.

tests_or_evidence_seen: wild_boar_proxy/web_design_ui/scripts/overview.js:3650-3674 now returns a `span.quick-start-row-action` with `aria-disabled="true"`, not a button and not a `data-ui-action` payload
wild_boar_proxy/web_design_ui/scripts/overview.js:3612-3621 formats ISO timestamps into operator copy instead of rendering raw ISO or `last check` text
wild_boar_proxy/web_design_ui/styles/overview.css:6634-6725 fixes the account-row grid to three columns with a bounded right column and styles the inert check marker without a dot
tests/test_web_design_ui.py:347-358 and 393-548 add coverage for the fixed two-column layout, no raw ISO / `last check`, no `data-ui-action` / `dataset.action`, and no status dot
`node --check`, unittest subset 112 OK, and `git diff --check` passed after the fix
risks: The audit evidence is strong but still artifact-based; the auditor did not independently rerun the browser or backend.
The `Проверить` marker is now inert and non-commanding, but it remains visually action-like by design, so copy and affordance should stay aligned with deferred-action intent.
